cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've stretched my stick over the ditch like your umbrella. Invisible bridge located. Tap for it before I cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm hooking my scarf out of the opposite hedge. Use your stick.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reach confirmed. Your umbrella gets across the ditch. Tap the empty space halfway across.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can feel a surface, but that doesn't mean it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; I want a convincing weight.
